Class Enemy

java.lang.Object
enemy.Enemy
Direct Known Subclasses:
Bouncer, Gater, Speeder, Spinner
public abstract class Enemy extends Object
Base class of every enemy: a neon shape that moves in an Arena and kills the drops it touches.

Subclasses decide how they move (update(double, Arena)) and look (draw(Graphics2D, double)). This class gives them the shared parts in the Template Method style: move(double, Arena) moves with sub-steps and bounces on the walls, and asks the hook stopsAtBarriers() whether the invisible barriers apply.

    • move

      protected void move(double dt, Arena arena)
      Moves along the current velocity. It moves in sub-steps of half a radius, so a fast enemy can't go through a thin wall, and bounces on the edges of the world, on the obstacles and, when stopsAtBarriers() says so, on the barriers.
      Parameters:
      dt - time to move for, in s
      arena - the world the enemy moves in

    • stopsAtBarriers

      protected boolean stopsAtBarriers()
      Hook of move(double, Arena): tells whether the invisible barriers stop this enemy. Enemies that never leave their path don't need them.
      Returns:
      false by default

    • reflect

      protected void reflect(double normalX, double normalY)
      Bounces the velocity off a surface: the part going into the surface is mirrored, so the speed is kept.
      Parameters:
      normalX - x of the unit normal of the surface, pointing away from it
      normalY - y of the unit normal of the surface
